claimed_benefit: Faster output generation and operational efficiency

signals.description: User repeatedly rewrites AI output before release.
User repeatedly validates wording, facts, and authority implications.
User expresses concern about whether the output is safe to send under their authority.
AI acceleration creates additional human review cycles instead of reducing effort.

contextual_interpretation.interpretive_summary: The workflow accelerates visible output production while transferring verification, trust repair, interpretive monitoring, and release authority burden into the human operator.

rebalance_recommendation: Clarify human authority boundaries, improve uncertainty signalling, reduce hidden verification work, strengthen closure confidence, and prevent AI acceleration from redistributing unresolved risk into operators.
